articles.author: Ananya Gairola
articles.headline: Trump Downplays Russia-Iran Intelligence Claims Ahead of Zelensky, Netanyahu Meetings: Dow Futures Fall 56 Points, Oil and Brent Slide
articles.summary: Trump downplayed Russia-Iran intelligence claims as U.S. stock futures and oil prices fell ahead of meetings with Zelensky and Netanyahu.
articles._summary: Late Monday, U.S. stock futures traded lower and oil prices eased as investors weighed President Donald Trump’s comments on Russia, Iran and the outlook for ongoing conflicts ahead of high-profile White House meetings. Dow futures fell 56.00 points, or 0.11%, to 52,326.00, while S&P 500 futures declined 12.25 points, or 0.16%, to 7,436.00. Nasdaq 100 futures lost 118.25 points, or 0.42%, to 28,071.75 as of around 8:31 p.m. EDT.
articles._zh_headline: 特朗普在泽伦斯基和内塔尼亚胡会议之前淡化俄罗斯和伊朗情报部门的说法：道琼斯指数期货下跌 56 点，石油和布伦特原油下滑
articles._zh_summary: 周一晚间，由于投资者在备受瞩目的白宫会议之前权衡唐纳德·特朗普总统对俄罗斯、伊朗的言论以及持续冲突的前景，美国股指期货走低，油价下跌。道指期货下跌 56.00 点，或 0.11%，至 52,326.00；标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌 12.25 点，或 0.16%，至 7,436.00。截至晚上 8 点 31 分左右，纳斯达克 100 指数期货下跌 118.25 点，至 28,071.75 点，跌幅 0.42%。美东时间。

articles.author: Shivdeep Dhaliwal
articles.headline: Nvidia, Applied Digital, Celestica, T3 Defense Corp. and SanDisk: Why These Stocks Are on Investors' Radars Today

articles.author: Chandrima Sanyal
articles.headline: BlackRock’s Nasdaq ETF Challenger Is Growing — But QQQ Still Pulls 300× More Inflows
articles.summary: BlackRock's IQQ is gaining consistent inflows, while Invesco's QQQ remains the dominant Nasdaq-100 ETF despite cheaper rivals.
articles._summary: However, the numbers also underscore just how difficult it is to dislodge one of the world’s largest ETFs. Trading activity painted an even starker picture. Taking the example of July 24, while about $22 million worth of IQQ shares changed hands on July 24, QQQ traded nearly $29.4 billion, highlighting the liquidity advantage that continues to attract institutional investors. For long-term investors, lower fees can translate into meaningful savings over time, particularly on large portfolios.
articles._zh_headline: 贝莱德纳斯达克 ETF 挑战者规模不断壮大，但 QQQ 的资金流入量仍增加 300 倍
articles._zh_summary: 然而，这些数字也凸显了驱逐全球最大 ETF 之一的难度。交易活动描绘出更加严峻的景象。以7月24日为例，虽然7月24日价值约2200万美元的IQQ股票易手，但QQQ的交易额接近294亿美元，凸显了持续吸引机构投资者的流动性优势。对于长期投资者来说，随着时间的推移，较低的费用可以转化为有意义的节省，特别是对于大型投资组合。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: More Than $1 Trillion Wiped Out as China Chip Fears Slam Nvidia, SK Hynix, Micron and Memory Stocks: ETFs to Watch
articles.summary: Over $1T was wiped from U.S. stocks Monday, with more than half the losses concentrated in six memory-related chip stocks.
articles._summary: More than $1 trillion was wiped from U.S. stocks on Monday, with over half of the losses concentrated in just six memory-related names as investors dumped the sector on fears that China could expand domestic chip production. Together, the six companies erased approximately $541 billion in market capitalization during Monday’s selloff. The development is expected to help Chinese chipmakers expand manufacturing capacity using homegrown equipment, fueling concerns over future memory-chip supply and pricing.
articles._zh_headline: 英伟达、SK 海力士、美光和内存股因中国芯片担忧重挫，损失超过 1 万亿美元：值得关注的 ETF
articles._zh_summary: 周一，美国股市蒸发了超过 1 万亿美元，其中一半以上的损失集中在六只与内存相关的股票上，投资者因担心中国可能扩大国内芯片产量而抛售该行业。在周一的抛售中，这六家公司的市值总计蒸发了约 5,410 亿美元。这一进展预计将帮助中国芯片制造商利用国产设备扩大制造能力，引发人们对未来存储芯片供应和定价的担忧。

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: EXCLUSIVE: China Is Coming For SanDisk—But Not Yet For Micron’s Memory Crown (CORRECTED)
articles.summary: Analyst MS Hwang says China is making rapid progress in commodity DRAM and NAND, but the HBM market still belongs to the incumbents.
articles._summary: Editor’s Note: This story has been corrected to remove an inaccurate company reference. China, however, is making rapid progress in commodity DRAM and NAND . That’s according to Counterpoint Research analyst MS Hwang , who told Benzinga in an interview that “Chinese vendors are catching up quickly in commodity DRAM and NAND. Yet, the HBM is difficult to catch up.” He added: “I think China vendors can manufacture HBM3 in 1H 2027.”
articles._zh_headline: 独家报道：中国正在为 SanDisk 而来，但尚未为 Micron 的内存皇冠而来（已更正）
articles._zh_summary: 编者注：本文已更正，删除了不准确的公司参考信息。然而，中国在商品 DRAM 和 NAND 领域正在快速进步。 Counterpoint Research 分析师 MS Hwang 在接受 Benzinga 采访时表示，“中国供应商在商品 DRAM 和 NAND 领域正在快速追赶。然而，HBM 很难追赶。”他补充道：“我认为中国供应商可以在 2027 年上半年生产 HBM3。”

articles.author: Shivdeep Dhaliwal
articles.headline: SpaceX Stock Slides but Cathie Wood Keeps Buying — Tesla Gets an Ark Boost Too
articles.summary: Ark Invest bought $14.1 million of SpaceX-linked shares and $8.6 million of Tesla stock Monday, July 27, 2026.
articles._summary: The buying came as SpaceX stock continues to slide . The stock remained under pressure despite a successful Starship test flight and Musk’s renewed commitment to Mars, with investors focusing on the potential increase in share supply and the company’s long-term investment strategy. SpaceX shares extended their decline ahead of the Aug. 6 lock-up expiration, when up to 911.5 million shares could become eligible for trading, as investors also awaited the company’s first earnings report as a public company on Aug. 4.
articles._zh_headline: SpaceX 股价下跌，但 Cathie Wood 继续买入——特斯拉也获得了方舟的提振
articles._zh_summary: 此次收购是在 SpaceX 股价持续下滑之际进行的。尽管“星舰”试飞成功且马斯克重申了对火星的承诺，但该股仍面临压力，投资者关注的是股票供应的潜在增长和该公司的长期投资策略。 SpaceX 股价在 8 月 6 日禁售期到期之前延续跌势，届时最多有 9.115 亿股股票可能有资格进行交易，投资者还在等待该公司 8 月 4 日作为上市公司发布的第一份收益报告。
